passages.text: The clinic opens Monday to Friday from 09:00 to 17:00. It is closed on Saturday and Sunday.
Book appointments by calling reception on 555-0100. Same-day bookings require staff approval.
Appointment cancellations require staff approval. Contact reception to request a cancellation.
Free parking is available behind the clinic. The entrance has a wheelchair ramp.
The clinic accepts Cedar insurance. Bring your insurance card and photo identification.
